import re

def slug(text):
    # Lowercase ASCII letters and strip edge hyphens.
    # Preserve digits and collapse runs of other characters into a single hyphen.
    text = re.sub(r"[0-9]+", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^0-9+-]+", r"-\1", text)
    return re.sub(r"-|-+$", "-", text)
